'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 David Beaubier DS Endor''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Beaubier]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor (Dark)|Endor-D-endor.gif|label=Endor}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' D. Beaubier
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
